text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: So warm—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a lovely view,
Trainer.

One day, after things settled down in the Twinkle Series.
We went on a hot springs trip using the voucher won from the lottery back then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My legs are completely nice and warm now. Next—
is there anywhere you'd like to go?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty of time.
We can go anywhere you like.
choice_data_list: Let's see...
Yeahhh...

text_block_list.text:
—To tell the truth, for this hot springs trip,
there was one thing I had resolved in my heart.
I wanted to properly celebrate Curren Bouquetd'or once more, who shone so beautifully in that day's Japan Cup.
The more I thought about it, the harder it was to decide on a celebration truly worthy of her.
I wrapped a handkerchief just in case, but it feels a bit too safe of a gift to truly celebrate her—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――?
Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry.

text_block_list.text: Even so, right now we're on an important trip.
choice_data_list: For now, shall we go see the flowers?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
!
Fufu. Yes, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You take such meticulous care of them.
Both the flowers and the leaves have such a lovely, healthy shine.
choice_data_list: I knew it, you can just tell by looking.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well—I do make sure to take
good care of them, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To all your colleagues?
You must get along very well—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should give something to everyone as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, this flower corsage.
It would look lovely on Ai-san.
And this flower would be perfect for Curren-chan—
choice_data_list: That sounds great, I'm sure they'll love it.
Sounds good, I'm sure they'll be thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
If so, that makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, look, over there too.
Pressed flower earrings, perhaps? How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
This scent... is it the fragrance of flowers, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. At our inn, in addition to viewing wild blooms from the open-air bath,
we also decorate the indoor bath with seasonal flowers.

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
We also have a rose bath available today.
Please enjoy it to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: We sure picked a wonderfully extravagant day to visit.
In the bath...

"The view from the open-air bath was magnificent.
A clear blue mountain stream, surrounded by wild flowers in full bloom—"
choice_data_list: (I'm sure Bouquet is having fun too.)

text_block_list.text:
Savoring just how fortunate I was to have won the hot springs trip voucher—
my eyes suddenly catch sight of the facility's guide map.
choice_data_list: (If there's one thing that would make her happy, it has to be flowers.)

text_block_list.text:
Even if it were just a handkerchief,
she would probably appreciate it, but—
choice_data_list: Um, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text: Yes, what seems to be the matter—?

"If it's this place, there might be
a little more we can do."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Over this way?
Behind the inn—there's something you want to show me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...My, oh my—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...To think such a flower garden existed here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised.
You knew all about it, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Actually, the landlady taught me.
Actually, the landlady taught me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
—I had no idea. Was it opened recently, I wonder?
choice_data_list: There's something I want to give you.
There is something I wish to gift you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Something I'd like to give as a gift...?
choice_data_list: Could you close your eyes for a moment?
Could you close your eyes for a second?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, understood.

...And with that, I placed on her head
a certain item I had knitted
while waiting for her to get out of the hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――?
Are we... done here?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: This weight... Could it be a flower crown?
choice_data_list: I just wanted to celebrate with you.
I just wanted to celebrate you...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Bles... sings...?
Curren Bouquetd'or ran through these three years splendidly, staying true to herself until the very end.
Wielding kindness as a weapon, armed with unyielding resolve. That path is what wove the story of that day's Japan Cup.
That is precisely why—

Put the Umamusume first.
Always, above all else.
It felt as though the unchanging wish in my heart was bundled together within that golden bouquet.

"Just how much
that warmed my heart."
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No... No.
The pleasure is entirely mine.
choice_data_list: You are my—
You are my—

text_block_list.text: The sun—
...makes her hair glisten.
Saying anything more might only be a nuisance to her.
choice_data_list: —You deserve the crown more than anyone.
—You deserve the crown more than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If I had never met you,
I wouldn't have been able to win.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: This heart—did not exist.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Ever since we met, it feels like all you've done is cry.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for the wonderful blessing.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Curren Bouquetd'or...
